evidence.title: Forget Buc-ee’s, this is the US’s favorite convenience store, new report shows

occurrences.checkable_against: ACSI 2026 convenience store customer satisfaction report
occurrences.quote_span: Meijer improved five points to a score of 82 out of 100 on this year’s report.
occurrences.speaker: ACSI
occurrences.subject: U.S. convenience store customer satisfaction rankings

occurrences.checkable_against: ACSI annual convenience store ranking tables
occurrences.quote_span: Topping the list last year was Kwik Trip, the Wisconsin-based fuel chain that has spread throughout the Midwest. The brand slipped slightly this year, ranking third overall on ACSI’s rankings.
occurrences.speaker: ACSI
occurrences.subject: U.S. convenience store customer satisfaction rankings

occurrences.checkable_against: ACSI 2026 regional convenience store rankings
occurrences.quote_span: In the latter, Wawa edged out Buc-ee’s by a single point.
occurrences.speaker: ACSI
occurrences.subject: U.S. convenience store customer satisfaction rankings

occurrences.checkable_against: ACSI annual convenience store ranking tables
occurrences.quote_span: No convenience store chain fell as much in the rankings as Kwik Trip, which lost six points off last year’s score, ACSI’s data shows.
occurrences.speaker: ACSI
occurrences.subject: U.S. convenience store customer satisfaction rankings

occurrences.checkable_against: ACSI 2026 regional convenience store rankings
occurrences.quote_span: Wawa was the top spot in the Northeast and the South.
occurrences.speaker: ACSI
occurrences.subject: U.S. convenience store customer satisfaction rankings

occurrences.checkable_against: ACSI 2026 regional convenience store rankings
occurrences.quote_span: Wawa was the top spot in the Northeast and the South.
occurrences.speaker: ACSI
occurrences.subject: U.S. convenience store customer satisfaction rankings

occurrences.checkable_against: ACSI 2026 convenience store customer satisfaction report
occurrences.quote_span: Many of those locations also offer fueling stations, which scored the highest customer satisfaction rates among those surveyed this year.
occurrences.speaker: ACSI
occurrences.subject: U.S. convenience store customer satisfaction rankings

occurrences.checkable_against: ACSI 2026 regional convenience store rankings
occurrences.quote_span: Meijer did not, however, rank as the top-rated brand in the Midwest, according to the ACSI. That spot was claimed by Sheetz, which edged out Meijer by a single point when broken down by region.
occurrences.speaker: ACSI
occurrences.subject: U.S. convenience store customer satisfaction rankings

occurrences.checkable_against: ACSI 2026 convenience store ranking table
occurrences.quote_span: - Buc-ee’s, Maverik, Pilot, RaceTrac, and Shell: 77
occurrences.speaker: ACSI
occurrences.subject: U.S. convenience store customer satisfaction rankings

occurrences.checkable_against: ACSI 2026 convenience store customer satisfaction report
occurrences.quote_span: Benchmarks analyzed included store hours and locations, food quality, store layout and cleanliness, merchandise variety, and even the quality and freshness of coffee.
occurrences.speaker: ACSI
occurrences.subject: U.S. convenience store customer satisfaction rankings

occurrences.checkable_against: ACSI 2026 convenience store ranking table
occurrences.quote_span: - Meijer: 82

occurrences.checkable_against: ACSI 2026 regional convenience store rankings
occurrences.quote_span: In the West, Maverik and QuikTrip tied.

occurrences.subject: U.S. convenience store customer satisfaction rankings

occurrences.checkable_against: ACSI 2026 convenience store customer satisfaction report
occurrences.quote_span: The latest data from the American Customer Satisfaction Index (ACSI) shows that an entirely different retailer, known primarily for serving an entirely different industry, is the top convenience store brand in the U.S.
occurrences.speaker: ACSI
occurrences.subject: U.S. convenience store customer satisfaction rankings

occurrences.checkable_against: ACSI 2026 convenience store ranking table
occurrences.quote_span: - Kwik Trip and Murphy USA: 79
occurrences.speaker: ACSI
occurrences.subject: U.S. convenience store customer satisfaction rankings

occurrences.checkable_against: ACSI 2026 convenience store customer satisfaction report and Meijer rewards-program savings records
occurrences.quote_span: The ACSI noted that customers appreciate the retailer’s rewards program, which reportedly saved customers $200 million over the previous year.
occurrences.speaker: ACSI
occurrences.subject: U.S. convenience store customer satisfaction rankings

occurrences.checkable_against: ACSI annual convenience store ranking tables
occurrences.quote_span: Three chains — Love’s, Cumberland Farms, and Sunoco — dropped five points.

occurrences.subject: U.S. convenience store customer satisfaction rankings

occurrences.checkable_against: ACSI 2026 convenience store ranking table
occurrences.quote_span: - QuikTrip, Sheetz, Wawa: 80

occurrences.checkable_against: Meijer corporate store and geographic footprint records
occurrences.quote_span: You may better recognize the name for the hundreds of grocery stores it operates across six states: its home state of Michigan, as well as Ohio, Indiana, Illinois, Wisconsin, and Kentucky.
